title: Colts lose to Chiefs in OT as Shane Steichen, horrible defense face heavy criticism
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver recap the Indianapolis Colts' overtime loss against the Kansas City Chiefs. Colts coach Shane Steichen was surprisingly conservative with his late-game play-calling, which may have cost Indy the chance at a walk-off win. The bigger issue, however, is that the Colts have the worst defense in the league, with no clear avenues for improvement. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
